question:
Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.

CAP, FIG, MAN, SIT
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 

The pattern followed is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ab8ea1ef23916b9df6512181a49f4dd6ca9dc59deba791588aa27e16ba30385.png] 

So, CAP is the odd one.

Hence **the correct answer is option 1).**
